items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: That's the boy I raised up with me. We come up with little kids together.

ctx.x: Okay. All right. And you know, I was speaking to Fat's son.
Fat Pechon's son? Yeah. I didn't know he had a son.

Oh, he's got a boy. If you see his boy, you'll sway him. Really? Yeah, a fine boy. I didn't know that. Built just about like you. I was speaking to him in the hardware store Monday. And I asked him about his daddy's cell. I spoke to him Sunday long distance. He said he's not any better. He said he's not any better. That's the boy I raised up with me. We come up with little kids together. Fat nine.
